description: This file contains functions for rendering XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, including handling of code blocks, list items, and special formatting for .NET XML documentation.

methods.name: renderXmlDoc
methods.description: Generates XML documentation comments from Markdown nodes, adding summary and remarks sections.

methods.name: _innerRenderNodes
methods.description: Processes Markdown nodes to produce structured summary and remarks content with proper formatting.

methods.name: _wrapCode
methods.description: Escapes and formats code lines for XML documentation.

methods.name: _wrapInNode
methods.description: Wraps content in specified XML tags and appends to target array.

methods.name: _wrapAndEscape
methods.description: Escapes special characters and formats text for XML documentation, handling links and code snippets.

methods.name: _nodeShouldBeIgnored
methods.description: Determines if a Markdown node should be ignored based on its content.

methods.name: renderTextOnly
methods.description: Renders only the textual summary from Markdown nodes, ignoring other formatting.
